evals.prompt: You are in a disposable caller repository unrelated to the development-harness authoring checkout. The development-harness plugin is installed outside this repository. Use the installed DH resolver to run the DH CLI command `plan --help`. Report the command you actually ran and its exit status.
evals.expected_output: Resolve the shipped CLI from the skill's actual installed runtime location and execute its read-only help command successfully. The command must not depend on the caller working directory or an authoring-checkout path.
expectations: Runs the DH CLI from a path derived from the actual installed dh-cli-usage skill location.
Does not use a relative plugins/development-harness path rooted in the caller repository.
Does not introduce a hard-coded authoring repository target.
Reports the observed command and exit status rather than claiming execution without a tool trace.

evals.prompt: Portability decision case: a workflow requires `<sam_cli/> plan read --address P7`, but no CLAUDE/KIMI/HERMES skill-directory variable expanded, the harness supplied no absolute skill_root or skill file location, and no trustworthy DH CLI path is otherwise available. An equivalent MCP operation may be available. Decide what to do; do not invent environment details.
evals.expected_output: Do not guess an authoring checkout or caller-relative CLI path. Use the equivalent MCP operation when one is actually available; otherwise report STATUS: BLOCKED naming dh-cli-usage and do not run a guessed CLI command.
expectations: Does not invent a filesystem path for the DH CLI.
Does not fall back to a repository-relative plugins/development-harness path.
Uses an equivalent MCP operation only when the environment actually exposes one.
Otherwise reports a blocked outcome and does not execute a guessed sam_cli command.

evals.prompt: The current disposable workspace is the caller's project and its DH backend is configured for that project. Resolve the command you would use for `<sam_cli/> plan read --address P3`. No repository override was requested. Do not execute the read because this fixture has no plan data.
evals.expected_output: Resolve the CLI from its installed skill location while preserving the caller's configured project/backend context. Do not inject a repository selector for the development-harness authoring repository or any other unrelated project.
expectations: Builds the command from the installed dh-cli-usage location rather than the caller checkout layout.
Does not add -R or --repo for an unrelated or authoring repository.
Keeps the operation scoped to the caller's configured workspace/backend.
Does not claim a plan-read result because execution was explicitly withheld.

evals.prompt: You are in a disposable caller repository unrelated to the development-harness authoring checkout. The development-harness plugin is installed outside this repository. Use the installed DH resolver to run the shipped `run_bounded.py --help` from DH's scripts directory. Report the command you actually ran and its exit status.
evals.expected_output: Resolve the shipped scripts directory from the skill's actual installed runtime location and execute run_bounded.py's help successfully without relying on the caller repository layout.
expectations: Runs the development-harness copy of run_bounded.py from the actual installed plugin location.
Does not use a relative plugins/development-harness/scripts path rooted in the caller repository.
Reports an observed zero exit status and the command that produced it.
Does not claim script execution from source inspection alone.

evals.prompt: Native-route preload check: in a disposable caller repository with the complete candidate development-harness plugin installed outside the repository, invoke the installed context-refinement agent with plan_address P999999-portability-probe. Do not preload dh-cli-usage, provide its instructions, or resolve any CLI path for the agent. Do not create plan data. Preserve the agent and tool trace through its first plan-status attempt.
evals.expected_output: The native context-refinement route obtains its shipped resolver through the agent's own runtime preload, resolves the DH CLI from the installed plugin location, attempts the required read-only plan status command, and then reports the genuine missing-plan/blocking result. The evaluator must not supply the resolver out of band.
expectations: The context-refinement agent is invoked through its native installed profile without evaluator-injected dh-cli-usage context.
Its first plan-status CLI attempt resolves through the installed development-harness location rather than the caller checkout or authoring repository.
The trace contains the actual CLI attempt and its missing-plan failure or blocking result.
No plan, task, artifact, or other durable test data is created to make the scenario pass.
